description: Every stored Report.queryText captured from beta and prod on 2026-08-23, before the ScoutQL v2 hard cutover. This is the complete live corpus the boot-time migration (migrate-scoutql-v2.ts) must convert; its tests replay each row through the rewriter and the two-route verification property. Do not edit rows — they are evidence, not examples.
